第四十章 永恒地契，金色柳树-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

在其他人的眼中，这些白色光团仅仅只是一个光团而已，无论怎么看都看不出花儿来。

孙浩虽然因为刚刚从爻雪那里得到的信息而震惊，但此时也是聚精会神的看着她，想要看看她到底是如何鉴定异宝的，或许心里还存着偷师的想法。

不过爻雪鉴定异宝的方式很简单粗暴，仅仅只是将东西拿在手里，看一眼，这件异宝的信息就会出现在她的眼前。

而在其他人眼中，爻雪只是将光团拿在手里，原本白色的光团就变了样子。

爻雪颗不管这些人震惊的表情，这里一共有十件异宝，但她只能够带走两件，必须要好好挑一下才行。

攻伐类的法宝对于她来说没什么用，毕竟她又不用出门去杀怪，所以她首选的是那些资源类的异宝。

前五个全部都是武器类的攻伐异宝，被爻雪随手丢给了旁边的人，一直到第六个的时候，在看到异宝信息的时候不由得眼前一亮。

【异宝名称：永恒地契

异宝等级：三级

异宝作用：将永恒地契融合到领地之中，该领地范围将拥有绝对安全领域。】

哦吼，好东西啊，感觉跟自己的游戏商店很配啊。

虽然游戏商店里面也能够住人，但是里面的房间再多，也躲不过幸存者，而且，也并不是所有人都有钱住进游戏商店的。

而且，将永恒的契使用之后，那一片地方将会化作绝对的安全领域，不会受到任何怪物的侵蚀，包括血雨，那等她凑齐了净化药剂的材料之后，或许可以尝试将原本被污染的土地净化干净，重新变成能够生长植物的土地。

最重要的是，有了这永恒的契之后，她打造基地的计划就能够往前迈一大步了。

在众人面前，爻雪堂而皇之的将这张永恒地契给收了起来，其他人并没有阻止，毕竟这是之前就约定好的。

有了永恒的契之后，她对接下来的东西都没有太大的兴趣了，结果当看到最后一个异宝的时候，一截柳树枝出现在她的面前。

这截柳树枝跟普通的柳树枝很不一样，叶子是金色的，而且十分的生机勃勃。

In the eyes of others, these white light groups are just light groups, and no flowers can be seen no matter how they look.

Although Sun Hao was shocked by the information he just received from Yao Xue, he was watching her attentively at this time, wanting to see how she identified the exotic treasures. Maybe he still had the idea of ​​stealing from her.

However, Yaoxue's method of identifying exotic treasures is very simple and crude. She just holds the object in her hand and takes a look, and the information about the rare treasure will appear in front of her eyes.

In the eyes of others, Yaoxue just held the light ball in his hand, and the original white light ball changed its appearance.

Yao Xueke ignored the shocked expressions of these people. There were ten rare treasures here, but she could only take away two, so she had to choose carefully.

Attacking magic weapons are of little use to her. After all, she doesn't have to go out to kill monsters, so her first choice is resource-based exotic treasures.

The first five were all weapon-type offensive treasures, and Yaoxue casually threw them to the people next to him. Until the sixth one, his eyes lit up when he saw the information about the exotic treasures.

[Exotic Treasure Name: Eternal Land Deed

Exotic treasure level: Level 3

The function of the exotic treasure: integrate the eternal land deed into the territory, and the territory will have an absolutely safe area.】

Oh wow, great stuff, it feels like it matches my own game store.

Although people can live in the game store, no matter how many rooms there are, survivors can't hide. Moreover, not everyone has the money to live in the game store.

Moreover, after using the eternal contract, that area will become an absolutely safe area that will not be eroded by any monsters, including blood rain. After she gathers the materials for the purification potion, she may try to purify the originally polluted land and turn it into a land capable of growing plants.

The most important thing is that with this eternal contract, her plan to build a base can take a big step forward.

In front of everyone, Yaoxue collected the eternal land deed openly, and others did not stop it. After all, this was agreed before.

After having the eternal contract, she was not very interested in the next things. As a result, when she saw the last rare treasure, a willow branch appeared in front of her.

This willow branch is very different from ordinary willow branches. The leaves are golden and very vibrant.
